known_outcomes: All five primary and the post-mixture calibration development/null outcomes known. Noise mix passed all treatment guards but failed nulls; post-mixture calibration improved nulls but failed treatment guards. No outcome for this seventh fixed arm known.
formula: Use the fixed mean50 response and initial0.30expected+0.65Poisson+0.05empirical population, then one further unchanged dual-moment calibration, same seed and200 iterations. No parent row mixing, weight grid or new fitted parameter.
selection: Same frozen original mean/null/count thresholds and scoring, no relaxation. Additional count confirmation remains required if selected.
early_stop: Require every corrected control-null DE-call count <=V24. If any fails, do not run treatment counts or additional confirmation.
